title: Seats hold one of three roles (viewer, editor, owner), each with a fixed set of toolsets; a viewer holds none, retired admin/developer read as editor, owners alone manage people
steps: S1: From the repository root run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok: ROLES is owner, editor, viewer and only viewer and editor are invitable; actingEditor accepts a live owner or editor and never a viewer, a pending seat or a retired name; permissionsFor and toolsetsFor give one fixed set per role and nothing to a viewer.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/seats/roles.js ROLES, INVITABLE_ROLES, normalizeRole, actingOwner, actingEditor, permissionsFor, toolsetsFor

fence: Pure functions of the seat book's role rules (ADR 0028); no database, no network.

tests: ROLES: the three roles of ADR 0028, widest first; only viewer and editor are invited
actingEditor: a live owner or editor; never a viewer, a pending seat or a retired name
permissionsFor and toolsetsFor: one fixed set per role, a viewer holds none
